scripts.deploy:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env staging && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.deploy:production: test "$STENMONT_CONFIRM_PRODUCTION" = yes || (echo 'Refusing: set STENMONT_CONFIRM_PRODUCTION=yes after staging is verified and approved' && exit 1); wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env production && wrangler deploy --env production
